review.note: 2026-09-06: added energy_fatigue to the goal list, at product's request, as the sanctioned alternative to a symptom-based question ('do you feel tired before the gym?') the questionnaire deliberately doesn't ask (see data/questionnaire.md's explicit non-goals) - goal-based gating stays the only signal, just widened to cover low-energy/fatigue explicitly. Needs re-review since it changes what was approved 2026-09-05. Prior note, still true: this rule does not subtract existing dietary caffeine (coffee/tea) since no profile field exists for it - a daily coffee drinker may be recommended an additional caffeine supplement on top of dietary intake.
